The eigenvalue of the operator K on the degenerate basis state |n⁽⁰⁾;q⟩.

Gravitational potential energy, E_p = mgh near the Earth's surface, measured from a chosen zero level.
Gravitational potential energy, mgh, measured from a chosen zero level.

meanings.text: With δ in front, δH_nl,p = ⟨n⁽⁰⁾;l|δH|p⁽⁰⁾⟩, the complex conjugate of δH_p,nl.

a_Ik⁽⁰⁾: the coefficient of the degenerate state |n⁽⁰⁾;k⟩ in the good state |ψ_I⁽⁰⁾⟩.
a_I⁽⁰⁾: the column vector of coefficients a_Ik⁽⁰⁾ that describes the good state number I.
E_nI(λ): the energy of the good state I; E_nI⁽²⁾, the second-order correction, is an eigenvalue of M⁽²⁾.
M_lk⁽²⁾: an entry of the second-order matrix, −Σ_p δH_nl,p δH_p,nk/(E_p⁽⁰⁾ − E_n⁽⁰⁾).
The hydrogen wavefunction with quantum numbers n, l and m.
Hydrogen's ground-state wavefunction, e^(−r/a₀)/√(πa₀³).
In nS_1/2: an l = 0 multiplet with total angular momentum j = ½ (2 states).
In nP_1/2: an l = 1 multiplet with j = ½ (2 states).
In nP_3/2: an l = 1 multiplet with j = 3/2 (4 states).
In nD_3/2: an l = 2 multiplet with j = 3/2 (4 states).
In nD_5/2: an l = 2 multiplet with j = 5/2 (6 states).
With δ in front: the Darwin term, (ħ²/8m²c²)∇²V, a delta function at the proton for hydrogen.
With δ in front: the relativistic correction to the kinetic energy, −p̂⁴/(8m³c²).
With δ in front: the spin–orbit coupling, (e²/2m²c²)(1/r³) S⃗·L⃗.
The hydrogen S state (l = 0, m = 0) with principal quantum number n.
With δ in front: the Zeeman term, (eB/2mc)(L_z + 2S_z) for a field along z.
With δ in front: the fine-structure terms, relativistic, spin–orbit and Darwin, together.
With an arrow, the electron's orbital magnetic moment, −(e/2mc)L⃗.
The atom's internal magnetic field: the field the electron feels moving through the proton's electric field, responsible for spin–orbit coupling.

ω_ab = (E_a − E_b)/ħ: the angular frequency set by the energy difference of the two states.
The notes' name (p. 104) for ω_ba = (E_b − E_a)/ħ.
The energy of the eigenstate |m⟩ of H⁽⁰⁾.
The coefficient of |a⟩ in the interaction-picture state; |c_a|² is the probability to be in |a⟩.
The coefficient of |b⟩ in the interaction-picture state; |c_b|² is the probability to be in |b⟩.
The rate of change of the coefficient c_m with time, dc_m/dt.
The rate of change of the coefficient c_a with time, dc_a/dt.
The rate of change of the coefficient c_b with time, dc_b/dt.

The probability to find the system in |a⟩ after the kick.

The probability to find the system in |b⟩ after the kick.

c_m(t): the coefficient of another instantaneous eigenstate |ψ_m(t)⟩, m ≠ k.

P_fi(t): the first-order probability of a transition from the state i to the state f by the time t.

The energy the galaxy sends out during the short time Δt_e.
The total energy of the recoiling electron.
The rest energy of the electron, m_e c² = 0.510999 MeV.

δH_fi = ⟨f|δH|i⟩: the matrix element of the perturbation between the initial state i and the final state f.

The number of atoms in the lower level a.

Elastic potential energy stored in a stretched or squeezed spring, ½kx².

The third parameter of a three-dimensional configuration space.
The last (N-th) parameter of the Hamiltonian.

ν_n(t) = i⟨ψ_n|ψ̇_n⟩: a real rate whose time integral is the geometric phase γ_n.

The covariant derivative along x^α.

The gradient with respect to the position of particle i.

The charge enclosed by the closed surface S.

A charge on the far side of the equipotential surface; in the new problem it is an image charge.
Heat to warm the melted water from 0 °C to 100 °C.
Heat taken out to cool the ice from 0 °C to −18 °C.

The potential of the image charge, evaluated at the real charge Q.

The Levi-Civita symbol with indices k, j, i (equal to ε_ikj).

The k-th component of G, the first part of the dipole field.

The Kronecker delta: 1 if l = n, 0 otherwise.
